title: Show an experimental-software warning banner in the README and on every page of the public site
story: The README and every page of the public site now open with a warning that Maestro is experimental software with no warranty, and that users are responsible for what its AI agents do. On the Home page the warning is a strip above the top bar; on Features, Installation and Troubleshooting it is a red-edged box above the page title. Nothing in the app changed.

checks.criterion: The Home page shows the warning above everything else, with no horizontal scroll at phone width.
checks.steps: Open https://nachogl1.github.io/maestro/ in a 375px-wide window, then again at desktop width.
checks.expected: The warning starting 'Experimental software: use at your own risk.' sits above the Maestro top bar; the 'MIT licence' link opens github.com/nachogl1/maestro/blob/main/legal/LICENSE; no sideways scrolling.

checks.criterion: Features, Installation and Troubleshooting show the same warning above the page title, readable on a phone.
checks.steps: At 375px wide open the Installation and Troubleshooting pages; at desktop width open the Features page.
checks.expected: A red-edged box with the same warning text above the page heading, body-sized text, no sideways scrolling.

checks.criterion: The README shows the warning directly under the title.
checks.steps: Open the repository README on GitHub.
checks.expected: A quoted warning paragraph right under 'Maestro' and above 'Orchestrate multiple AI coding assistants in parallel'; its 'MIT licence' link opens legal/LICENSE.
